title: Customer addresses removed from RentaPC diagnostics and retained off-rig spools
criterion: INTENT SC7 / prohibition N1, owner correction C3
source_tag_note: Newest published tag at the time of work (21 tags seathub-v0.1.16..seathub-v0.1.37, 0.1.28 absent). `git diff --stat seathub-v0.1.37 fe6edc76` is docs/release-versions.md only, so app/seathub and tests at the published tag are byte-identical to the member base.
landing_revision_note: Not known at build time. The orchestrator records the immutable landing commit (and its hash) when the task lands; this receipt is then read by T027 at that revision. No SHA is invented here.
captured_utc_note: Coarse build-time stamp; the authoritative time is the landing commit's own committer date, recorded by the orchestrator.

verify.registry_note: All four suites were already registered by name in tests/run-all-suites.cmd; no new suite was added, so there is no zero-match pass. Named mode prints NAMED_SUITES_PASSED only after each suite's own `^Totals:.*, 0 failed` line is found.

fixtures.input_shape: One diagnostic body: a dial target with an IPv4 address and port, a bracketed IPv6 peer with port, a session id, a host id, a trace id, a release version and a standalone port number.
fixtures.assertions: Neither address literal remains; every non-address fact is byte-identical, including both ports and both ids.

fixtures.input_shape: Nine embedded forms in one input set: a credentialled URL, a plain sentence, a pairing query string, a backslash-escaped regex form, a JSON body, a bracketed IPv6 peer, a JSON IPv6 value, a fully written-out IPv6 with a port, and an IPv4-mapped IPv6 literal.
fixtures.assertions: No form survives; each sanitized line contains the redaction marker; a second pass (the SDK's own) changes nothing further.

fixtures.input_shape: One diagnostic line whose body carries an IPv4 address and whose attributes carry an address, an address-plus-port endpoint, a fixed-vocabulary step name, an integer attempt count, and a nested object holding an IPv6 peer plus an integer port.
fixtures.assertions: The retained on-disk copy is sanitized before any send; the shipped line is sanitized again; keys, integers and the port survive.

fixtures.input_shape: A spool file written the way an older release wrote it - an address in the body and an address in the retained attributes - then adopted by a new process, drained and re-sent.
fixtures.assertions: The already-retained copy carries no address on the way out, in either the body or the attributes.

live_envelope_readback.scenario: customer-address: a real child process with the real telemetry hand-off, sending to a loopback envelope collector, with no rig literal set at all (the ordinary case of dialling someone else's rig).
live_envelope_readback.assertions: No collected envelope contains the customer IPv4 or IPv6 in any form; the `play.step` log item reaches the envelope; its `address` and `peer` attributes carry no address; `endpoint` keeps `:47984`; `port` keeps 47989; every file left in the child's own spool directory is clean.
live_envelope_readback.note: This is the sanitized readback required by SC7: what would have left the machine is checked on the wire, not inferred from a unit assertion.

authority_preserved.statement: Network authority, pairing and dial inputs are not scrubbed by this task.
where: LogShipper::scrub() only rewrites text that is being emitted off the rig or retained for that purpose; it is not on any pairing, dial or control-plane path.
The rig-literal pass (setRedactions()/publishPairingTarget()) still runs first and still wins for the machine's own address.
No pairing, dial, control-plane or engine call site was edited by this task.
suites: tst_facade_wiring (319 passed, includes pairing and account-race cases)

c3_scope.owner_ruling: C3, 2026-11-07: keep the customer address in the rig's own local file log.
c3_scope.in_scope: Diagnostic output sent off the rig (the Sentry payload) and copies held off the rig (the support spool waiting to be sent).
c3_scope.out_of_scope: The rig's own local file log. This task does not edit that log, does not route it through LogShipper::scrub(), and does not supersede ADR-0071. Any export or upload of that log is still covered by the same rule, and would be a copy held off the rig.

account_and_consent.statement: Account binding, consent and revocation, lock ownership, and send/drop/retry/age/size semantics are unchanged. The scrub runs on the existing worker path, before the spool write and before the SDK call, and does not alter any gate decision.

limits.rig_local_file_log: Out of scope by C3; it keeps the address by owner ruling and is not exercised here.
limits.raw_minidumps: Crash dumps are outside the diagnostic payload path and are not covered by this receipt. The client deletes legacy SeatHub-*.dmp files and never uploads them (telemetry.cpp removeLegacyDumps()); nothing in this task changes that, and no claim is made about the contents of any dump a platform tooling might retain.
limits.third_party: Sentry-native's own internals, transport, and any server-side storage are third-party. This receipt proves what our code hands to sentry_log() and what our own spool retains; it makes no claim about third-party retention beyond that boundary.
limits.no_universal_scrub: This is a targeted redaction of address literals in our own emitted and retained diagnostics. It is not a universal byte-scrub, not a deletion promise, and not a claim about data already delivered before this change.
limits.integrated_check: T027 checks actual emissions and copies at the integrated revision; this receipt is the input it reads, and the landing revision is filled in by the orchestrator.
limits.loopback_and_wildcard: Loopback and wildcard literals (127.0.0.0/8, 0.0.0.0, ::, ::1) are deliberately left byte-identical: they are this machine's own endpoint facts and never identify a customer.

entry_points.LogShipper::scrub: body text: rig literal, existing secret patterns, then address literals
entry_points.LogShipper::scrubAttributes: diagnostic attributes, recursive, keys and non-string scalars untouched
entry_points.LogSpool::append: both body and attributes sanitised for every line that lands in the off-rig spool
entry_points.readSpoolFile: an older release's spool line is sanitised at read, so a retained copy is cleaned before it is re-sent
entry_points.Impl::processLine: second pass on the way to the SDK

implementation.no_engine_change: No engine code, updater, unknown-metric (M005) code, dependency or new suite was added.

t027_handoff: T027 reads this file at the landed revision: `fixtures[].sanitized_sha256` plus `verify.suites[].raw_locator`. `landing_revision` is null here because landing is the orchestrator's act; T027 must confirm it is no longer null before treating the receipt as immutable.
